summary: Backend (16/16 pytest passed) and frontend smoke + integration testing for Illinois UI Job Search Tracker. Auth, profile, benefit weeks CRUD, contacts CRUD, CSV import, audit log, dashboard, PDF report, cascade delete all verified. Screenshot endpoint validated for auth and bad-week-id 404 (skipped real Gemini call to save credits). Frontend login, dashboard, weeks page (create dialog), week detail (PDF button + add-contact + edit/delete row icons), profile save, audit log, import (file input) all render and function via demo credentials.
action_items: Add data-testid attributes to interactive elements (Login button, New Benefit Week, dialog inputs/save, Add Contact, Download PDF, Profile inputs/save, Edit/Delete row icons, nav links). Currently selectors must rely on text/roles which is brittle for automation.
Profile/dialog inputs lack id/name/placeholder attributes which hampers accessibility and tests.
Consider showing a success toast after Profile save and Benefit Week create — current flow gives no visible confirmation beyond list refresh.
server.py is 720+ lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/profile/weeks/contacts/import/reports) for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET correctly read from env (good). Bcrypt hash + verify_password robust.
Seed-update path keeps demo password in sync with .env on startup (good idempotency).
All endpoints exclude MongoDB _id via projection or pop — no ObjectId leakage.
CORS uses allow_credentials=False when '*' which is correct; Bearer-token auth works.
Screenshot endpoint properly validates week ownership before invoking Gemini — prevents wasted LLM credits.
PDF mirrors IDES ADJ034F style with claimant block + 3-row minimum + compliance summary.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed weeks/contacts; week_id fixture deletes its week at session end (cascades contacts). One extra week 2026-02-01→2026-02-07 created by frontend test remains for visibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all CRUD + import/CSV + PDF + audit + dashboard + cascade. Screenshot OCR not invoked against Gemini to conserve credits — pipeline validated via 401/404 checks only. Frontend interactive elements have NO data-testid yet; tests rely on text selectors.
